name: Domingo 22 Nov - Rucho Veiga / Pastkual / Bonus Bass
description: This event features a night of techno and hardtechno music with performances by Rucho Veiga, Pastkual, and Bonus Bass. It is organized by Prestige Invictus Music and takes place at Era Uma Vez no Porto.
longDescription:
Prestige Invictus Music presents a night of techno and hardtechno music at Era Uma Vez no Porto. The event, titled "Domingo 22 Nov - Rucho Veiga / Pastkual / Bonus Bass," is scheduled for Sunday, November 22, 2026.

The lineup includes Rucho Veiga, who will bring pure techno, followed by Pastkual accelerating into hardtechno, and Bonus Bass closing the night. The music runs from 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

Tickets are available at two price points: Pre-sale for €6.00 and Regular for €10.00. The venue is located at Rua da Madeira 126, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal.
